dct_description_sm: The overall objective of this thesis was to assess the extent of environmental and climatic variations in the area during the Holocene, since the last deglaciation, to provide a better understanding of their effects on lacustrine environments. One of the specific objectives was to explore primary productivity and the evolution of diatoms communities by analyzing changes in abundance, diversity and composition of the assemblages, to try to establish links between these variations and the regional environmental fluctuations.
dct_title_s: Limnological data from lakes in northernmost Ungava Peninsula, Nunavik
